rule_name: Account number is a valid NUBAN (CBN check digit)
Closure date present on closed accounts
Account file row count matches control total
BVN present for KYC tier 2 and 3
Phone is a valid Nigerian mobile (after standardisation)
Phone captured in E.164 at source
State of residence is one of the 36 states or FCT
Customer file row count matches control total
One device serial, one terminal ID
Terminal state is one of the 36 states or FCT
Terminal file row count matches control total
Status sent in the canonical vocabulary at source
POS transaction carries a terminal ID
Transaction time between 2020 and the batch cut-off
Transfer counterparty bank code is a known CBN code
Fee not larger than the amount
Amount within the KYC tier single-transaction limit
No successful debits after account closure
Every transaction channel delivered within its SLA
NIP transfer carries a session ID
Transaction file row count matches control total
